**Synopsis:**
A five-chart weekly digest covering: (1) Brent crude breaking $100/bbl on Middle East tanker strikes and Hormuz uncertainty embedding a lasting geopolitical risk premium; (2) sticky US inflation above 2% potentially forcing the Fed — under Kevin Warsh — to resume rate hikes, with August CPI the near-term catalyst; (3) ECB hiking 25bps to 2.50% with markets pricing two more hikes ahead; (4) the yen surging to a seven-month high on BoJ tightening expectations and repatriation flows, disrupting carry trade dynamics; (5) Apple's new CEO John Ternus launching the $1,999 foldable iPhone Duo, entering a Samsung/Huawei-dominated segment.
